character.title: XenoPixels Overview
character.subtitle: What this mod adds
character.detail: XenoPixels is a DragonMineZ companion mod for unique server content: custom forms, a Xenoverse-style HUD, Budokai/Sparking Zero combat movement, KI overcharge scaling, and server/client feature configs. Join the public server from JOIN XenoPixels (xpn.co.il).

character.title: XenoPixels HUD
character.subtitle: XV2-style combat UI
character.detail: Custom floating HUD: player skin portrait, name, cyan HP/KI numbers, gold KI bar, STM diamonds, release % next to the name, and a red transform-charge border while holding G. Default scale 0.50x. Move/resize via HUD LAYOUT or /xenohud edit. Toggle with /xenohud show|hide|toggle. Layout saves to config/xenopixelsmod-hud.json.

character.title: DMZ HUD Control
character.subtitle: Server-wide overlay gate
character.detail: Ops can hide the stock DragonMineZ HUD for everyone with /dmzhud off (or /xenoserver set dmzhud false). Default is OFF so XenoPixels HUD can replace it. State syncs to all clients and is stored in config/xenopixelsmod-server.json.

character.title: Client & Server Configs
character.subtitle: Feature flags + costs
character.detail: Client: config/xenopixelsmod-client.json — HUD, menu buttons, combat feel, glow/SFX. Commands: /xenoclient reload|status|set <key> true|false. Server: config/xenopixelsmod-server.json — combat toggles, KI/stamina costs, kick launch, KI overcharge, chase chance. Commands: /xenoserver reload|status|set <key> true|false.

character.title: KI Overcharge
character.subtitle: Release above 175%
character.detail: When power release exceeds 175%, fired DMZ KI attacks grow: size, damage, and explosion radius scale per excess percent. Tunable via kiOverchargeThreshold, kiOverchargeSizePerPercent, kiOverchargeDamagePerPercent, kiOverchargeExplosionPerPercent, kiOverchargeMultiplier, kiOverchargeMaxScale. Toggle: /xenoserver set overcharge true|false.

character.title: Server Entry
character.subtitle: xpn.co.il
character.detail: Title screen and pause menu open the XenoPixels menu. JOIN XenoPixels connects straight to hostname xpn.co.il. Buttons can be disabled in client config (title, pause, join, menu, content, edit).

skills.title: BT3 / Sparking Combat
skills.subtitle: Requires DMZ lock-on (except air kick)
skills.detail: Budokai Tenkaichi / Sparking Zero style movement layered on DMZ. Most techs need lock-on. Server can disable any piece via /xenoserver set. Client can mute local feel via /xenoclient set.

skills.title: Vanish Behind
skills.subtitle: Double-tap A or D
skills.detail: Close-range IT-style snap behind the lock-on target (~7 blocks). Costs vanishKiCost KI (default 8). Uses DMZ evasion sounds. Toggle: bt3VanishEnabled / bt3VanishClient.

skills.title: Chase Dash
skills.subtitle: Double-tap W · 50% success
skills.detail: Mid-range rush-in toward lock-on (default ≤14). Costs chaseKiCost KI (12). Success chance chaseSuccessChance (default 0.50). Fail = small lunge + message. Toggle: bt3ChaseDashEnabled.

skills.title: Backstep
skills.subtitle: Double-tap S
skills.detail: Step away from lock-on while staying faced. Costs backstepKiCost KI (6). Toggle: bt3BackstepEnabled.

skills.title: Lock-on Combos
skills.subtitle: Mash attack while locked
skills.detail: 5-hit string (maxComboSteps) with rising damage and a stronger finisher on the last hit. Small KI tax (comboKiCost / finisherKiCost). Toggle: bt3ComboEnabled / bt3FinisherEnabled.

skills.title: Charge Fist
skills.subtitle: Hold R → release
skills.detail: Hold to charge (DMZ charge_light/heavy punch anim + orange glow at max). Release spends fistChargeStaminaCost stamina (scales with charge %). Needs a target. Toggle: bt3ChargeAttackEnabled.

skills.title: Charge Kick
skills.subtitle: Hold Middle Mouse → release
skills.detail: Hold middle mouse to charge (DMZ heavy charge + kick anim, pink glow). Works without a target (air kick). On release: Hold W = launch target UP; Hold S = stomp DOWN with longer reach (kickDownRangeBonus, default +4). Stamina: kickChargeStaminaCost + kickVerticalExtraStamina when using W/S. Always plays hit SFX on contact.

skills.title: Dragon Dash
skills.subtitle: Hold N → release
skills.detail: Charge with DMZ ki_charge pose + gold glow. On release: smash target, launch them, then probabilistic chase (same chaseSuccessChance). Costs dragonDashStaminaCost + dragonDashKiCost. Toggle: bt3DragonDashEnabled.

skills.title: DMZ Animations
skills.subtitle: Real DMZ player anim system
skills.detail: Charge holds and releases use DMZ MeleeAnimationS2C / TriggerAnimationS2C (charge_light_punch, charge_heavy_punch, ki_charge, punches, lowkick/gutkick, dash). Nearby players see the same poses.

skills.title: Cost Reference (defaults)
skills.subtitle: Edit xenopixelsmod-server.json
skills.detail: KI: vanish 8 · chase 12 · backstep 6 · combo 1.5 · finisher 5 · dragon 10. Stamina: fist 18 · kick 18 · hold/sec 4 · dragon 22 · kick vertical extra 4. Kick launch: kickUpLaunch 1.35 · kickDownLaunch 1.15 · kickDownRangeBonus 4. After edits: /xenoserver reload.

skills.title: Master Shops
skills.subtitle: Where to buy form skills
skills.detail: All XenoPixels form skills (fan SS, divinity, saga, dark frieza) are skillOfferings on Beerus and Whis only. Vanilla superforms/godforms unchanged. Bootstrap installs form JSON + patches skills.json on server start.

skills.title: Useful Commands
skills.subtitle: Quick reference
skills.detail: Client: /xenohud toggle|edit|reset · /xenoclient reload|status|set. Server ops: /dmzhud on|off|toggle · /xenoserver reload|status|set. DMZ: /dmzreload config after form/price JSON edits.
